title: Cardinal Rental Reimbursement Endorsement Schedule: When Rental Begins and Ends
content:
**Schedule to the Cardinal Rental Reimbursement endorsement: start and end days**

The days below set when a covered rental may begin and how long it remains paid after certain claim events. Each is stated for every option.

## Start of rental

| Option | Vehicle can still be driven | Vehicle cannot be driven | Total theft: calendar days after the theft is reported before rental may start |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 30/900 | Day the vehicle is dropped at the shop | Day the loss was reported | 1 |
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 40/1200 | Day the vehicle is dropped at the shop | Day the loss was reported | 1 |
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 50/1500 | Day the vehicle is dropped at the shop | Day the loss was reported | 1 |
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 60/1800 | Day the vehicle is dropped at the shop | Day the loss was reported | 0 |
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 75/2250 | Day the vehicle is dropped at the shop | Day the loss was reported | 0 |
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 100/3000 | Day the vehicle is dropped at the shop | Day the loss was reported | 0 |

## Days still paid after an ending event

| Option | After the shop reports repairs complete | After the total-loss settlement offer | After a coverage denial is communicated (rental already running) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 30/900 | 1 | 3 | 1 |
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 40/1200 | 1 | 3 | 1 |
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 50/1500 | 1 | 3 | 1 |
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 60/1800 | 1 | 5 | 1 |
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 75/2250 | 1 | 5 | 1 |
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 100/3000 | 1 | 5 | 1 |

## Meaning of each entry

1. *Vehicle can still be driven:* rental starts on the day the vehicle is dropped at the shop.
2. *Vehicle cannot be driven:* rental starts on the day the loss was reported.
3. *Total theft waiting days:* the number of calendar days after a total theft is reported before rental may start, a whole number.
4. *After repairs complete:* the days after the shop reports repairs complete through which rental is still paid.
5. *After a total-loss settlement offer:* the days after the total-loss settlement offer through which rental is still paid.
6. *After a coverage denial:* the days after a coverage denial is communicated through which a rental already running is still paid.

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical dates)

- On Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 75/2250, a total-loss settlement offer made on June 10 leaves rental paid through June 15, five days after the offer. On Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 40/1200 the same offer leaves rental paid through June 13.
- A shop that reports repairs complete on June 10 leaves rental paid through June 11 on every option.
